title: Tenders & Quotations
body:
## Government Polytechnic College, Kannur ### Official Tenders & Quotations Notice Board Sealed competitive tenders/quotations are invited by the Principal, Government Polytechnic College, Kannur, for institutional procurement and services. Complete specifications, terms, and conditions are available in the official notification documents linked below. --- ### Current Open Tenders & Quotations | Sl. No. | Quotation / Tender Reference | Description of Work / Item | Last Date & Time | Document | Status | |:---:|---|---|:---:|:---:|:---:| | 1 | **PTA/01/2026-27** | **Printing of Identity Cards for First Year Students**
*(CR-80 Standard Format • Qty: 456 Nos.)* | **22.10.2026
10:00 AM** | [📄 Download PDF](/uploads/tenders/Quotation_Notice_PTA_01_2026-27_ID_Card_Printing.pdf) | 🟢 **Open** | --- ### General Terms & Instructions to Bidders 1. **Submission**: Quotations/tenders must be submitted in sealed covers superscribed with the tender reference number and addressed to the **Principal, Government Polytechnic College, Kannur, Thottada P.O., PIN - 670007**. 2. **Due Date**: Late or unsealed tenders will not be accepted under any circumstances. 3. **Rates**: Rates quoted should be inclusive of all taxes, duties, freight, and installation/delivery charges wherever applicable.
